answer_1.quote: We adopt BLIP2-Flan-T5-XL as the answer generator. It takes the concatenation of text embeddings (question and retrieved documents) and visual embeddings (image) as input. ... the generator outputs an answer for each retrieved document and selects the best candidate answer by the joint probability of retrieving and the generated answer.
answer_1.outputs: Natural language answers to visual questions

answer_2.quote: To assess the final accuracy of VQA, we employ the VQA Score and Exact Match (EM) metrics for OK-VQA. For Infoseek, we utilize the built-in evaluation metric, Infoseek Score.
